from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document: its title and stated cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
